brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu declared during a visit to Gaza that Israel has no plans to withdraw from the territory, according to Al Jazeera English. The statement underscores the Israeli government's commitment to maintaining its military operations and presence in the enclave as the conflict continues.

Netanyahu's remarks come amid ongoing operations in Gaza and reflect Israel's publicly stated position that it will remain engaged in the territory. The timing and location of his visit — inside Gaza itself — appear designed to reinforce the message directly to both Israeli and international audiences about the government's resolve in the conflict.
dek: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has said Israel does not plan to withdraw from Gaza.
title: Netanyahu vows Israel will not withdraw from Gaza
